## Checks

- [ ] `pnpm build:eve`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Tests are added or updated for changes to parsing, checks, export or the eve tools
- [ ] If reading changed: `pnpm bench -- --cases bench/cases` was run, and the result is described above
- [ ] `README.md` and `README.th.md` are both updated (or the pull request says the Thai text needs doing)
- [ ] No real receipts or slips, values copied from them, keys or `.env.local` in the change
